label: Card beside the face
description: A card to the left or right of the face, level with it; it may overlap the side of the head or the ear, never the eyes, nose or mouth. With no readable room beside a close-up face it goes over the hair on that side; if even that can't read, it is shown above the speaker in a split view instead, and the render result says so.

side.help: left | right | auto (auto = the side with more room)

iconic.help: true for a logo/icon (reads smaller); default: guessed (transparent background or tiny image)
